content.summary: The attributed A1K degree cap is imported with all required hypotheses, and does not assume the target I(27). The canonical snapshot, manuscript, and inspected imported-source digests match. This focused source check finds no circular premise or attribution mismatch.

checks.scope: Imported degree-at-most-19 theorem and its applicability
checks.method: Read Erdos20ExtremalTransversals.intersecting_rank_four_card_ge_twenty_one_degree_le_nineteen in the frozen F01 package, checked its manifest hash, and compared its hypotheses with Theorems 3–4.
checks.observation: The imported theorem requires a finite rank-four sunflower-free intersecting family with cardinality at least 21, and concludes degree at most 19 for every ambient point. Exact cardinality 28 supplies the numerical premise. Its short proof invokes the degree-20 upper bound and the implication that an intersecting degree-20 family has exactly 20 members; it does not invoke I(27), a boundary-profile exclusion, or an external computational theorem. The manuscript’s use and named attribution are therefore supported.
